prompt:
[calm, professional, over the radio] Horizon security, this is Shield dispatch, Vera speaking. First shift? Let me quickly show you what's on your monitors.

Along the bottom are the building's cameras. Tap one. Try three, the elevators.

Your job is to notice what's wrong. See the elevator display? Floor thirteen. The building only has twelve.

Tap Log and pick what it is. This time, Elevator.

That's it. Once it's logged, it goes away. Miss three in an hour, and you'll be in trouble.

Top left is the camera mic. When the bars jump, there's a sound. Log that too.

The console runs the floor lights, the entrance and the elevator. By ten, lock the entrance and stop the elevator.

The logbook has your instructions and the previous guard's notes. Read them while it's quiet.
[calm, professional, over the radio] One more thing. If a camera shows static, don't stare at it. Log it and switch right away. That's all. Have a good shift.
